title: Microsoft Entra: cross-tenant synchronisation of security groups
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documentation supports the opt-in default, licensing, group restrictions and automation calls. Minor corrections should complete the assignment and monitoring paths and remove the checklist's scope-setting instruction, which has no corresponding control row.

claims.claim: Cross-tenant synchronization creates, updates and deletes B2B collaboration users and groups across tenants.
claims.quote: Cross-tenant synchronization automates creating, updating, and deleting Microsoft Entra B2B collaboration users and groups across tenants in an organization.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists the feature as Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phases are General Availability and Preview.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)", "GCC", "GCC High", "DoD"]

claims.claim: The roadmap platform is Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap general availability target was April CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "April CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview date is January CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "January CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Group synchronization is admin-opt-in: the source group mapping defaults to No and must be enabled, with inbound group synchronization allowed by the target.
claims.quote: If you want to synchronize groups, set the Enabled toggle to Yes. By default, this toggle is set to No.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; summary; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Group synchronization requires a Microsoft Entra ID Governance or Microsoft Entra Suite licence for each synchronized user in the source tenant, supporting the per-user model.
claims.quote: Synchronizing a group and its members requires a Microsoft Entra ID Governance or Microsoft Entra Suite license for each synchronized user in the source tenant.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The licensing table includes same-cloud group synchronization in Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Microsoft Entra Suite and Microsoft 365 E7.
claims.quote: Feature | Free | Microsoft Entra ID P1 | Microsoft Entra ID P2 | Microsoft Entra ID Governance | Microsoft Entra Suite | Microsoft Agent 365 | Microsoft 365 E7; Cross-tenant synchronization for groups (same cloud) | | | | ✅ | ✅ | | ✅

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The synchronization itself requires no licence in the target tenant.
claims.quote: Licenses aren't required for cross-tenant synchronization or cross-cloud synchronization in the target tenant. However, depending on the features you're using in the target tenant, you might need additional licensing.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Entra admin center path reaches Allow group synchronization into this tenant through the partner's Inbound access, Inherited from default and Cross-tenant sync tab.
claims.quote: Under Inbound access of the added organization, select Inherited from default. Select the Cross-tenant sync tab. ... Optionally, select the Allow group synchronization into this tenant checkbox.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: PATCH /beta/policies/crossTenantAccessPolicy/partners/{id}/identitySynchronization sets inbound group synchronization through groupSyncInbound.isSyncAllowed.
claims.quote:
PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/policies/crossTenantAccessPolicy/partners/90e29127-71ad-49c7-9ce8-db3f41ea06f1/identitySynchronization
... "groupSyncInbound": { "isSyncAllowed": true }

claims.claim: A Security Administrator in the target tenant configures cross-tenant access settings.
claims.quote: Target tenant ... Security Administrator role to configure cross-tenant access settings.

claims.claim: At the time of writing, the inbound group setting is documented in beta but not the v1.0 update endpoint, whose synchronization property is userSyncInbound.
claims.quote: Searched: cross tenant group synchronization groupSyncInbound v1.0 meter pricing per group. Opened Update crossTenantIdentitySyncPolicyPartner in beta and v1.0 and crossTenantGroupSyncInbound: beta documents groupSyncInbound; the full v1.0 request-body table lists displayName and userSyncInbound only.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Entra admin center path reaches Allow role-enabled group synchronization into this tenant on the same partner Cross-tenant sync tab.
claims.quote: Select the Cross-tenant sync tab. ... To synchronize role-assignable groups, also select Allow role-enabled group synchronization into this tenant. Keep both group synchronization checkboxes selected.

claims.claim: The printed Set-MgBetaPolicyCrossTenantAccessPolicyPartnerIdentitySynchronization call accepts the partner tenant ID and GroupSyncInbound and RoleEnabledGroupSyncInbound hashtables containing Boolean IsSyncAllowed.
claims.quote: -CrossTenantAccessPolicyConfigurationPartnerTenantId <string> ... [-GroupSyncInbound <IMicrosoftGraphCrossTenantGroupSyncInbound>] [-RoleEnabledGroupSyncInbound <IMicrosoftGraphCrossTenantRoleEnabledGroupSyncInbound>]; ROLEENABLEDGROUPSYNCINBOUND ... [IsSyncAllowed <Boolean?>]

claims.claim: The role-enabled synchronization cmdlet belongs to Microsoft.Graph.Beta.Identity.SignIns.
claims.quote: Module: Microsoft.Graph.Beta.Identity.SignIns Module

claims.claim: The target tenant must select the group and role-enabled group synchronization checkboxes together to allow role-enabled synchronization.
claims.quote: To synchronize role-assignable groups, also select Allow role-enabled group synchronization into this tenant. Keep both group synchronization checkboxes selected.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Role-enabled group synchronization is preview.
claims.quote: For role-enabled group sync (preview), a role-assignable group in the source tenant.

claims.claim: Role-enabled synchronization can create role-assignable groups in the target tenant.
claims.quote: Role-enabled group sync lets you create role-assignable groups in the target tenant.

claims.claim: Role-enabled synchronization copies role-assignability, not source role assignments; roles are assigned separately in each target tenant.
claims.quote: Role-enabled group sync synchronizes the group's ability to receive role assignments. It doesn't copy role assignments from the source tenant. Assign the required roles separately in each target tenant.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The source configuration's Provisioning > Mappings > Provision Microsoft Entra ID Groups > Attribute Mapping > Enabled path controls group provisioning.
claims.quote: On the Provisioning page, under the Mappings section, select Provision Microsoft Entra ID Groups to open the Attribute Mapping page. If you want to synchronize groups, set the Enabled toggle to Yes.

claims.claim: PUT /v1.0/servicePrincipals/{id}/synchronization/jobs/{jobId}/schema updates the job schema containing the group object mapping.
claims.quote: Update the synchronizationSchema for a given job or template. ... PUT https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/servicePrincipals/{id}/synchronization/jobs/{jobId}/schema

claims.claim: The schema update operation replaces the entire current synchronization schema.
claims.quote: This method fully replaces the current schema with the one provided in the request.

claims.claim: The group objectMapping's enabled Boolean determines whether that mapping is processed.
claims.quote: enabled | Boolean | When true, this object mapping will be processed during synchronization. When false, this object mapping will be skipped.

claims.claim: The newer interface exposes the group's mapping under Attribute mapping > Groups.
claims.quote: Select Attribute mapping > Groups. If your configuration uses the older interface, select Provisioning > Mappings > Provision Microsoft Entra ID Groups.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Entra ID > Cross-tenant synchronization > Configurations > configuration > Users and groups > Add user/group reaches the group assignment interface.
claims.quote: On the configuration page, select Users and groups. ... Select Add user/group. On the Add Assignment page, under Users and groups, select None Selected.
claims.fix: Complete controls[3].ui.path as 'Entra ID > Cross-tenant synchronization > Configurations > configuration > Users and groups > Add user/group > Add Assignment > Users and groups > None Selected > Users and groups > group > Select > Assign', following https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/multi-tenant-organizations/cross-tenant-synchronization-configure step 7. The existing path stops early at the correct assignment interface.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/servicePrincipals/{id}/appRoleAssignedTo assigns a group to the configuration's service principal.
claims.quote: Assign an app role for a resource service principal, to a user, group, or client service principal. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/servicePrincipals/9028d19c-26a9-4809-8e3f-20ff73e2d75e/appRoleAssignedTo

claims.claim: The assignment request body's principalId identifies the group being assigned.
claims.quote: principalId: The id of the user, group or client servicePrincipal to which you are assigning the app role.

claims.claim: Cloud Application Administrator or Application Administrator can assign users to a cross-tenant synchronization configuration.
claims.quote: Cloud Application Administrator or Application Administrator role to assign users to a configuration and to delete a configuration.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Group synchronization requires Sync only assigned users and groups, and does not support Sync all users.
claims.quote: The synchronization scope must be set to Sync only assigned users and groups. The Sync all users option isn't supported when group synchronization is enabled.

claims.where: controls[4].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Entra ID > Cross-tenant synchronization > Configurations > configuration > Provisioning logs reaches the configuration's monitoring logs.
claims.quote: In the source tenant, on the Overview page ... Select Provisioning logs to determine which objects have been provisioned successfully or unsuccessfully. By default, the logs are filtered by the service principal ID of the configuration.
claims.fix: Set controls[4].ui.path to 'Entra ID > Cross-tenant synchronization > Configurations > configuration > Overview > Provisioning logs' to include the page heading named in step 13 of https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/multi-tenant-organizations/cross-tenant-synchronization-configure.

claims.claim: GET /v1.0/auditLogs/provisioning retrieves tenant provisioning events.
claims.quote: Get all provisioningObjectSummary events that occurred in your tenant, such as the deletion of a group in a target application ... GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/auditLogs/provisioning

claims.claim: The provisioning log API is read-only monitoring, not a synchronization setting.
claims.quote: GET /auditLogs/provisioning ... If successful, this method returns a 200 OK response code and a collection of provisioningObjectSummary objects in the response body.

claims.claim: Cross-tenant synchronization changes in the target tenant are logged with Microsoft.Azure.SyncFabric as the actor.
claims.quote: Cross-tenant synchronization in the target tenant will be logged as the actor being the "Microsoft.Azure.SyncFabric" application.

claims.claim: When a group is synchronized, its members who are in synchronization scope are synchronized with it.
claims.quote: When a group is synchronized, all members of the group who are in scope for synchronization are synchronized.

claims.claim: Static and dynamic source security groups are supported.
claims.quote: Supported | Security group (static and dynamic)Microsoft 365 group | Security group (static)

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 groups are supported as source groups.
claims.quote: Supported | Security group (static and dynamic)Microsoft 365 group | Security group (static)

claims.claim: Supported source groups are created as static security groups in the target tenant.
claims.quote: Support | Source | Target ... Supported | Security group (static and dynamic)Microsoft 365 group | Security group (static)

claims.claim: Nested groups are not supported.
claims.quote: Nested groups aren't supported.

claims.claim: The service does not update an existing target group created outside cross-tenant synchronization.
claims.quote: If a group exists in the target tenant (created outside cross-tenant synchronization), cross-tenant synchronization doesn't update it.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Membership determines access granted to the synchronized group, including SharePoint sites, apps and roles assigned in the target tenant.
claims.quote: Members – inherit permissions and access assigned to the group ... Access to Microsoft 365 resources, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint sites ... Use Microsoft Entra security groups to assign ... Elevated permissions

claims.claim: Subsequent synchronization cycles run approximately every 40 minutes.
claims.quote: The initial cycle takes longer to perform than subsequent cycles, which occur approximately every 40 minutes as long as the Microsoft Entra provisioning service is running.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Target-side group edits persist until a source group change causes them to be overwritten.
claims.quote: Changes to the group in the target tenant aren't overridden automatically. They're overridden only if there's a change to the group in the source tenant.

claims.claim: isAssignableToRole is set during target group creation and cannot be changed afterwards.
claims.quote: The isAssignableToRole property is set when the target group is created and can't be changed afterward.

claims.claim: Adding the role-assignability mapping does not convert previously synchronized non-role-assignable target groups.
claims.quote: Adding the mapping doesn't convert previously synchronized non-role-assignable target groups.

claims.claim: Once configured and running, the provisioning service automatically creates and updates groups and memberships.
claims.quote: Cross-tenant synchronization automates creating, updating, and deleting ... users and groups ... When a group is synchronized, all members of the group who are in scope for synchronization are synchronized.

claims.claim: Increasing object and membership volumes can lengthen synchronization cycles.
claims.quote: As the overall volume of objects and references increases, the time required to evaluate and synchronize changes can also increase. In environments with high scale, this can result in longer synchronization cycles and increased latency

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends scoping synchronization to only necessary users, groups and relationships.
claims.quote: To optimize performance, scope synchronization to only the users, groups, and relationships that are necessary.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Same-cloud user synchronization requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 in the source tenant.
claims.quote: Each user who's synchronized with cross-tenant synchronization must have a Microsoft Entra ID P1 license in their home/source tenant.

claims.claim: Using groups solely to scope user synchronization, without synchronizing the groups, requires Microsoft Entra ID P1.
claims.quote: Using groups only to determine which users are synchronized, without synchronizing the groups themselves, requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 licenses.

claims.claim: The licensing table does not include group synchronization under P1 or P2.
claims.quote: Feature | Free | Microsoft Entra ID P1 | Microsoft Entra ID P2 | Microsoft Entra ID Governance | Microsoft Entra Suite | Microsoft Agent 365 | Microsoft 365 E7; Cross-tenant synchronization for groups (same cloud) | | | | ✅ | ✅ | | ✅

claims.claim: Target tenants with External ID billing enabled that provision external guests might incur External ID charges.
claims.quote: Customers who enabled External ID billing and are provisioning external guests might be charged according to the billing model for Microsoft Entra External ID.

claims.claim: The target tenant needs at least one Microsoft Entra ID P1 licence to enable automatic redemption.
claims.quote: You also need at least one Microsoft Entra ID P1 license in the target tenant to enable autoredemption.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter and caps
claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no meter specific to group synchronization.
claims.quote: Searched: cross-tenant group synchronization pricing meter charge groups license Microsoft Entra. Opened cross-tenant synchronization overview, Entra licensing and External ID pricing and billing overview; group synchronization has per-user licence requirements, with separate External ID MAU billing.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter and caps
claims.claim: For B2B collaboration in workforce tenants, External ID uses monthly active user billing for external users with UserType Guest.
claims.quote: For B2B collaboration, the MAU billing model applies only to external users who have a UserType value of Guest.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter and caps
claims.claim: That B2B MAU billing does not apply to users originating within the organisation with UserType Member.
claims.quote: It doesn't apply to users who originate from within the organization and have a UserType value of Member.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter and caps
claims.claim: External ID billing requires an Azure subscription.
claims.quote: External ID requires an Azure subscription for billing.

claims.claim: Distribution groups are not supported for synchronization.
claims.quote: Not supported | All other group types, such as: - Mail-enabled security groups - Shared mailbox - Dynamic distribution groups - Distribution groups

claims.claim: Shared mailboxes are not supported for synchronization.
claims.quote: Not supported | All other group types, such as: - Mail-enabled security groups - Shared mailbox - Dynamic distribution groups - Distribution groups

claims.claim: Devices are not supported for cross-tenant synchronization.
claims.quote: You can synchronize Microsoft Entra users and security groups between tenants. Devices and contacts aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: Contacts are not supported for cross-tenant synchronization.
claims.quote: Devices and contacts aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn supports user and group synchronization from Azure commercial to Azure commercial.
claims.quote: Azure commercial | Azure commercial | Users and groups

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn supports user and group synchronization from Azure Government to Azure Government.
claims.quote: Azure Government | Azure Government | Users and groups

claims.claim: Synchronizing groups across Microsoft cloud environments is not supported.
claims.quote: Synchronizing groups across cloud environments such as Azure commercial, Azure Government, and Azure in China isn't supported.

claims.claim: Hybrid Identity Administrator configures cross-tenant synchronization in the source tenant.
claims.quote: Source tenant ... Hybrid Identity Administrator role to configure cross-tenant synchronization.

claims.claim: Security Administrator configures the source tenant's cross-tenant access settings.
claims.quote: Source tenant ... Security Administrator role to configure cross-tenant access settings.

claims.claim: Group provisioning is enabled in a cross-tenant synchronization configuration, with source mappings and assignments and target inbound permission governing what arrives.
claims.quote: A group isn't provisioned. | Check inbound group and role-enabled group synchronization permissions, group provisioning enablement, assigned scope, scoping filters, and provisioning logs.

claims.claim: Provisioning logs can report a skipped group with EntityTypeNotSupported.
claims.quote: Symptom - Group skipped due to EntityTypeNotSupported ... Group is skipped from synchronization because EntityTypeNotSupported.

claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to confirm the synchronization Scope setting, but the controls table contains no row for changing that setting.
claims.quote: after confirming the scope is Sync only assigned users and groups; controls table: inbound group permission, role-enabled group permission, group mapping Enabled, group assignments, provisioning logs.
claims.fix: Remove ', after confirming the scope is **Sync only assigned users and groups**' from the At rollout assignment bullet. Keep the documented scope prerequisite in Scope and the restriction in Risk assessment; do not add a control row.

claims.claim: Setting the target's inbound group synchronization setting to false stops current group synchronization from that partner.
claims.quote: false stops any current group synchronization from the source tenant to the target tenant.

claims.claim: Disabling inbound group synchronization does not remove or otherwise affect groups already synchronized.
claims.quote: This property has no impact on existing groups that were synchronized.
